_comment: Single source of truth for the Warm Heart narration audio contract (kokoro_warm add-on). scripts/master-narration-audio.sh and scripts/check-narration-audio.sh BOTH read this file, so the mastering target and the shipped-clip guard can never drift apart. Flat + language-neutral on purpose, so a non-bash caller (or a tiny HTTP daemon — see docs/KOKORO_WARM.md) can consume it too. Prose rationale: docs/NARRATION_VOICE_STANDARD.md. Bump specVersion on any change and record why in the voice standard.
